stories.h: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
b: huggingface.co: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation
arxiv.org: Interactive World Simulation with Cosmos for Physical AI
body: arxiv.org: arXiv:2611.06627v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a shared framework that adapts Cosmos world foundation models for real-time interactive world simulation in Physical AI. By streaming visual observations in response to actions and scene controls, the framework enables users and embodied agents to interact with evolving virtual environments. It supports both predicting the visual consequences of actions and generating observations from physical state maintained by an external simulator. We demonstrate this approach across camera navigation and robot manipulation, controllable video transfer, and multi-view autonomous vehicle (AV) simulation. These examples provide a shared foundation for developing interactive virtual environments for Physical AI training and evaluation. Our code and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/nvidia/cosmos and https://huggingface.co/collections/nvidia/cosmos3-examples. The project website is available at https://research.nvidia.com/labs/cosmos-lab/cosmos-simulation.
srcTitles: New NVIDIA Cosmos 3 Open Models for Interactive World Simulation

reddit.com: I have always had the desire to move to academia but I am not exactly sure how the process or profile building for academia works in general. Yeah, surely, I can ask AI and get answers but I don’t have much confidence in that . I did my PhD from a mid-tier school. My research focus was mostly on LLM model efficiency and some RL work (meta learning and bandit ) . The research direction I went with was totally out of my professor’s scope . As a result, I don’t have grant writing or funding related experience or don’t have those innovative idea of how do you create a research program or more specifically a niche sort of a program which I feel is required for Tenure track positions. During my PhD , I was able to hit top 3 ML( ICML,ICLR,Neurips )and top 3 NLP conferences ( ACL,EMNLP,NAACl) (in case having paper helps) . Being a grad student dictating his research, it went a bit scattered and not much concentrated on one research topic . For that I ended up joining a FAANG but still I want to get back to academia. I am looking for advice on how to build up my profile for academia and if it is possible to get into the top 150 US schools as tenure-track faculty and all . Thanks for your time ! submitted by /u/malakulmout347 [link] [comments]
